reason: I have run our compliance practice on Excel and WhatsApp for ten years, and I am deeply skeptical of disrupting our workflow with new software unless it proves dead simple. While spending two hours every Saturday reconciling pending GST filings is painful, I will not pay for software when our current spreadsheet system costs nothing and carries zero risk of assistants messing up our Drive structure.
objection: If files stay in our Google Drive, what happens if an assistant accidentally deletes or moves the folder?
would_change_my_mind: Testing the free pilot on actual client files to prove that assistants cannot tamper with Drive folders and that it genuinely eliminates my Saturday GST reconciliation without added complexity.
